data.command: ioreg -l -p IODeviceTree | grep -i boot-args 2>/dev/null || echo 'no boot-args entry found'

submissions.reason: Show the current boot-args NVRAM variable for a pre-reboot safety check by reading it from the IODeviceTree registry. Fully read-only — ioreg only queries the kernel object graph; no NVRAM variable is written or cleared.
